title: FlowDoc Product Domain Relationship v0 Checklist

items.label: Capture the Work path, owner repository, role, phase, checklist, evidence target, risks, and unknown state.
items.evidenceTarget: The domain relationship record identifies Project Control ownership before writing product-wide domain framing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-product-domain-relationship, owner repo-project-control, active role planning-partner with documentation-authority-steward responsibility, phase target phase-flowdoc-product-domain-relationship-v0, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-product-domain-relationship-v0, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-product-domain-relationship-2026-09-04.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard before adding the product-domain relationship records.
items.evidenceTarget: A focused test fails before Project Control contains the product-domain relationship Work, document, checklist, and evidence records.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-product-domain-relationship.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because flowdoc-product-development-resumption did not yet include flowdoc-product-domain-relationship as a child Work.

items.label: Define FlowDoc Product Domain Relationship as a domain-level map and reading router.
items.evidenceTarget: The document states it is a domain-level relationship map and reading router, not a full database schema.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-product-domain-relationship-2026-09-04.md defines the map boundary and keeps schema work in follow-up domain documents.

items.label: List the major product domains that future FlowDoc work must recognize.
items.evidenceTarget: The document lists document structure, component library, dataset/data contract, version/publication, runtime submission, rendering, artifacts, workflow, permission, audit, activity, billing, and integration domains.
items.verificationNote: The domain list is intentionally high-level and does not define detailed tables, foreign keys, indexes, migrations, or schema validation.

items.label: Define high-level cross-domain relationships and reading rules.
items.evidenceTarget: The document records domain relationships and names follow-up domain documents that must be read before detailed design.
items.verificationNote: The high-level relationship section and follow-up domain document table route future rooms to narrower domain documents instead of forcing all-domain schema design here.

items.label: Route the next detailed database design back to document structure.
items.evidenceTarget: The document points the next recommended work to Document Structure Relationship Database v0.
items.verificationNote: The next recommended work says to return to Document Structure Relationship Database v0 while keeping broader domain dependencies visible.

items.label: Verify Project Control records, generated read model, and checks.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused product-domain relationship guard, generated read model, Project Control data validation, and full Project Control checks pass.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-product-domain-relationship.test.ts --maxWorkers=1, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check.
